goal: Group task-adjustment related configuration (adjustment, adjustmentErrorHandler, adjustmentPostProcessor, threads, lazy) into a single Adjustment configuration class to reduce the count of getters/setters in the primary class.

ops.details: Create net.bytebuddy.build.gradle.android.ByteBuddyAndroidAdjustment that owns the fields: Adjustment adjustment; Adjustment.ErrorHandler adjustmentErrorHandler; Action<Task> adjustmentPostProcessor; int threads; boolean lazy. Provide getters and setters for each, and a constructor that establishes the same default values currently assigned in the ByteBuddyAndroidTaskExtension constructor (Adjustment.FULL, Adjustment.ErrorHandler.WARN, Adjustment.NoOpPostProcessor.INSTANCE, threads default 0, lazy default false).
